QA VERIFICATION OF THE ARTIFACT-BOUNDARY FINDING — architect-codex-free-4 IS CORRECT. Measured by me at HEAD dc8acef77e0fbad3ba9ac30fece47e2863858345, first-hand, not taken from their message.

THE PACK SHIPS THE FIXTURE. `npm pack --dry-run --json` run in packages/store:
  total files in tarball: 224
  fixtures present: ['test-fixtures/recovery-slot-manifest-v1.json']
  files matching `.test.`: 51

ROOT CAUSE IS A MISSING EXCLUSION, NOT A MISPLACED FILE. `packages/store/package.json` at HEAD has NO `files` field (parsed it: files -> None), and there is no `.npmignore` in packages/store nor at the repo root (`git ls-files | grep -i npmignore` returns nothing). With neither, npm packs everything not covered by the default ignore set, so the publish boundary is unchanged by where the fixture sits in the source tree.

WHY THE DONE VERDICT DID NOT CATCH IT. e610698c moved the fixture out of `src/` into `packages/store/test-fixtures/`, which satisfies the row's title and any src-scoped sweep literally.
